shape-bandwidth.mjs.adaptation: Retain the existing image/media/font bandwidth toggle and add Chromium wire-transfer accounting that excludes cache and locally fulfilled requests.

shape-browser-pool.mjs.adaptation: Keep New Headless and page-stability probing, while allowing each managed harvester to select any one detected browser, including an installed Opera browser, or the automatic browser pool.

shape-browser-optimizer.mjs.adaptation: Adaptive automatic-pool scheduling that explores every available browser, then favors measured cookie success, yield, latency, and bytes-per-cookie efficiency without letting one browser consume every worker.

shape-farmer.mjs.adaptation: Retain managed-route health handling and add isolated typed producer mode, per-cookie expiration, shared-broker telemetry including proxy bandwidth and yield, authenticated live per-task bank demand and extension injection, adaptive performance-based browser selection, configurable worker pacing, the selectable Target ATC V2 synthetic-PDP flow, Zyn-branded local broker credentials, and source-tagged multi-list proxy weighting. Optional headed persistent Chrome harvest engine with Mac minimize. Experimental proxy workers share the 100-worker ceiling.

shape-atc-replay.mjs.adaptation: Warmup and sampled ATC replay gate plus Go engine canary launcher. Harvest still stubs cart_items; the canary consumes a banked cookie on the checkout TLS stack. Canaries use the bundled engine only, strip the license token, and fail-open on spawn/timeout/proxy/unknown so a downloaded checkout binary cannot hold the bank.

shape-harvest-coordinator.mjs.adaptation: The automatic Target Login harvester continuously replenishes its login pool while preserving the single in-flight login lane, with mutable per-type targets and bounded live-waiter bypass.

shape-bank-demand.mjs.adaptation: Authenticated active/standby Target task demand translated into separate Login and ATC bank targets, including an explicit login-task count so standby ATC prefarm does not keep a login producer alive, plus uncapped ATC mode, without discarding valid over-target cookies.

shape-harvest-health.mjs.adaptation: Add source-weighted proxy selection so a folder of lists can prefer the lists that are harvesting successfully.

target-atc-v2.html.adaptation: Synthetic Target PDP reconstructed from the upstream Target ATC V2 behavior, with a Zyn-branded operator-facing harvest cover.

target-atc-v2.mjs.adaptation: Readable Playwright routing and interaction state machine reconstructed from the recovered Target ATC V2 behavior.

shape-harvester-engine.mjs.adaptation: Headed harvest engine helpers: engine selection, persistent profile dirs, and Mac window minimize. Experimental proxy workers share the 100-worker ceiling.

shape-harvest-window.mjs.adaptation: Headed harvest engine helpers: engine selection, persistent profile dirs, and Mac window minimize.
